verdict.rationale: Multi-entity consolidation is a fair question for a corporate spend and banking platform, so the axis applies, but the evidence pack never mentions multiple legal entities, consolidated reporting, or per-entity books. A USD-balance international account and cost-center or category analysis are adjacent features, not multi-entity accounting, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can run multiple legal entities and currencies in one account with consolidated reporting and per-entity books
